name: cavemio-hover-card
title: Hover card
description: A preview of what a link points to: it rises off the link after a rest, stays open while you move onto it, and closes after a short grace.

cavemio.usage: import { HoverCard } from "@/components/hover-card"; }> @ada
cavemio.accessibility:
- Placement, presence and dismissal come from floating.ts, shared with tooltip, popover and the menus.
- Nothing in the card should be the only way to reach something: touch and screen readers may never see it.
- Reduced motion: it fades.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: Travel-safe
features.description: Pointer on the link or the card keeps it open; 300ms grace after leaving both.

features.description: 600ms, so passing over links doesn't flash cards.

features.title: Keyboard
features.description: Focus opens it, Escape closes it.

features.title: Touch-honest
